Kerala Cricket Association Lifts Three-Year Ban on Former India Pacer S Sreesanth

The Kerala Cricket Association has revoked the three-year ban imposed on former India pacer S Sreesanth after he apologized for his critical remarks against the association. The decision was made in a special general body meeting, following Sreesanth's unconditional apology. This move allows him to continue as co-owner of the Aries Kollam Sailors football team.
